item.title: Senate permitting bill speeds up renewables, divides greens over oil and gas
item.description: A permitting reform bill in the Senate could help speed the development of renewable energy projects, but it's splitting environmentalists over other provisions that help the oil and gas industry.
item.content:encoded: A permitting reform bill in the Senate could help speed the development of renewable energy projects, but it's splitting environmentalists over other provisions that help the oil and gas industry.

item.title: Anthropic worker claims to have solved a Holy Grail of math problems with the help of AI
item.description: A mathematician who works for artificial intelligence giant Anthropic claims he has solved a Holy Grail of math problems with the help of the company's AI tool Claude. It marks the second time in recent months that an AI company or someone linked to one claims to have cracked a famed unsolved math problem.

item.title: Nations at UN talks on AI killer robots agree to more talks but no firm commitment to rein them in
item.description: Efforts to establish rules for AI-powered killer robots and drones have run aground. U.N.-backed talks in Geneva ended Saturday with an agreement to extend discussions for two more years.
